LanguageData.PM.Combo.GizmoDesc: Left-click to target and execute one combo. Right-click to configure. Continue at the last position if the target dies; stop if a move's requirements fail. Left-click an empty slot to configure it.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.InvalidRoute: This combo route is invalid. Right-click to edit it.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.Interrupted: Combo interrupted: Slash form cannot be controlled.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.Timeout: Combo interrupted: pursuit or waiting timed out.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.CounterFailed: Combo interrupted: the required successful counter and return hit did not occur.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.Conditions: Combo interrupted: blade grade, spirit, or follow-up requirements are not met.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.Unreachable: Combo interrupted: target position is unreachable.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.Name: Name
LanguageData.PM.Combo.Cost: Total spirit spent: {0} | Expected ending blade grade: {1}
LanguageData.PM.Combo.InvalidAt: Move {0} cannot follow. Remove/reorder it or change the starting blade grade.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.PreviewAssumptions: Preview assumes the chosen grade, full spirit and successful hits. Actual spirit and blade grade determine whether each move can execute. Helmbreaker and finishers include their existing automatic stages.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.CounterNote: Conditional route: Foresight must counter and land its return hit to continue. Iai must counter an incoming attack within its sheathe window, or the combo stops.
LanguageData.PM.Combo.UnfinishedStance: Add a follow-up to finish the sheathe stance before saving.
